 How to download the RRB ALP CBT 1 Hall Ticket 2026
 Go to the RRB ALP admit card 2026 official regional website login
 Click on the respective regional link
 That link will redirect you to the respective RRB regional website.
 Then, click on the “RRB ALP CBT 1 admit card download link”
 A new login window will be displayed on your screen
 Enter your user ID and password to download the “RRB ALP admit card 2026”
 After clicking Submit, the “RRB ALP CBT 1 hall ticket” will be displayed
 Download and take a printout of the RRB ALP admit card for the exam day.

 What to do if there are any mistakes in the RRB ALP Admit Card 2026?
 If there are discrepancies with the details mentioned in the RRB ALP admit card 2026, candidates are advised to follow the steps given below.
 Email, call, or visit the respective offices of the RRBs to which they have applied.
 While mentioning the discrepancies, candidates must convey everything correctly.
 They will also need to produce certain documents, such as the application form details, during the process.
 If the errors are valid and have been made by the board, RRBs will issue fresh RRB ALP 2026 hall tickets after correction.
 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
 Q: What login details are required to download the RRB ALP 2026 hall ticket? A: You need your Registration Number and Date of Birth / Password through the official candidate login link.
 Q: Is the RRB ALP City Intimation Slip the same as the Admit Card? A: No. The city slip gives advance information on your test city and date, whereas the E-Call Letter is the mandatory final admit card required to enter the exam hall.
 Q: What documents must be carried to the RRB ALP exam centre? A: You must bring a printed copy of the admit card and a valid photo ID matching your application details.
 Q: Is biometric verification mandatory for RRB ALP 2026 Exam? A: Yes. Aadhaar-based biometric authentication is required at the examination venue
